notes: kb/Work PB546 (w1070 A), decision PB3099. Rule (cite.py --check 13.18.60.4 OK, GR8): 'National characters shall be represented in the storage of the computer as characters of a uniform size equal to or a multiple of the size of characters in the computer's alphanumeric character set'; D-N1 specifies two bytes (UTF-16BE). ONE uniform size is now spelled once, PicInfo.BytesPerPosition (usage-keyed), and every byte count reads it: ElementaryByteWidth, RefModPlace.PositionBits, RecordLayout.ImageContribution, ItemLength r2, FileModel.MaxDynamicExtent / RecordImageUnit / IsNationalRecord, the dynamic-length LENGTH arms of IntrinsicBinder, the SUPPRESS WHEN key positions. Measured on the w1070 A build: 01 G. 05 N PIC N(2). 05 A PIC X(2). gives LENGTH 6, BYTE-LENGTH 6, G(5:2) = YZ; usage-national boolean, numeric, numeric-edited and national-edited items occupy two bytes a position whole and sliced; MOVE of a three-byte group into PIC N DYNAMIC LENGTH leaves two positions and LENGTH 4 (D-N8, was 6), and back into a 4-byte group gives 'ABC '.
